rationale: With only 2 minutes remaining until market close, there is effectively no time to capture a meaningful move, and any position entered now would be forced to close almost immediately at the market-on-close print, introducing significant slippage risk. While the stock is showing strength — up ~15% on the day, trading at 98.3% of its range, and pushing toward the session high — entering a momentum long or a fade short with a 2-minute window provides no viable risk/reward structure. The 5-minute ATR of $0.37 further limits the achievable move relative to execution costs.
